title: Konductor usage-analytics telemetry event envelope
description: Per-invocation event schema. This is the shape of the outer envelope's 'Data' field, not the full wire-level request -- the outer envelope wraps this object with Solution/Version/UUID/TimeStamp.

eventId.description: sha256_hex() over (UUID + nanosecond timestamp + the reporting process's own PID). Disambiguates concurrent invocations from different processes -- not guaranteed unique across a single flush batch (skill-lookup-mcp's flush task can build several events per cycle in one process).

eventType.description: Open, additive enum -- a consumer must tolerate an eventType it doesn't yet recognize rather than reject the event outright. The seven values known today: agent_invocation, subagent_invocation, mcp_tool_call, cli_error, package_uninstalled, package_installed, package_version_updated. Deliberately not expressed as a closed JSON Schema `enum` -- a closed enum would reject any future/forward-compatible value, contradicting this field's own documented contract.

targetName.description: Meaning depends on eventType: an agent/sub-agent name (agent_invocation/subagent_invocation); tool_name or tool_name:skill_name (mcp_tool_call); the failed subcommand's name -- init/install/update/uninstall/synth/doctor/config (cli_error); the target's harness value (package_uninstalled/package_installed/package_version_updated).

sessionId.description: sha256_hex(UUID + the runtime's own session identifier). Present on agent_invocation/subagent_invocation events on harnesses that expose a session identifier (Claude Code); null on mcp_tool_call, cli_error, package_uninstalled, package_installed, and package_version_updated (no runtime session), and null on every event type for harnesses with no session identifier in their hook payload (Kiro CLI, confirmed absent).

parentSessionId.description: Null unless a sub-agent event. Holds the same value as that event's own sessionId (the parent's sessionId, not its eventId) -- a sub-agent event's parentSessionId is the delegating session's own sessionId, computed the same way.

errorCode.description: Null on every eventType except cli_error (always) and a failed mcp_tool_call. A stable, closed error-category string -- never the underlying error's own Display/message text, which can contain a local filesystem path or caller-supplied argument.

harness.description: Populated only on cli_error events, copied verbatim from the identity record. Null on every other eventType -- package_uninstalled/package_installed/package_version_updated carry their harness value through targetName instead, not through this field.

TimeStamp.description: ISO 8601, UTC. Matches the outer envelope's own TimeStamp field by name only -- this field keeps ISO 8601 format; the outer field uses a different, space-separated format.

count.description: Only present on mcp_tool_call events (skill-lookup-core's own report_mcp_tool_call): the number of accumulated calls this flush cycle folded into one event under this (tool_name, skill_name, errorCode) key. Not part of the core per-invocation shape every other eventType shares -- allowed here, rather than made required, since a future eventType has no reason to carry it.
